title: 2022 U.S. domestic freight flows by state, commodity and mode
citation: U.S. Department of Transportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics (2022). Freight Analysis Framework, FAF6 [datasets].
publisher: U.S. Department of Transportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics

filter.label: Domestic flows (freight shipments moved from US domestic origins to US domestic destinations)

interpretation: These are estimated commodity flows for the 2022 benchmark. The 50 states and the District of Columbia are separate reporting units.
The domestic selection excludes trade types 2 and 3, including the U.S. legs of imports and exports. Intrastate flows have identical origin and destination state codes.
The rows identify state endpoints, commodity group and transportation mode. They provide no observed route or intermediate stops.
Source-listed zeros remain explicit. A combination without a row is unavailable. Group sums cover the selected source rows. No estimate is created for an absent combination.
Summing inbound and outbound totals across states counts a shipment twice. Category 02 covers cereal grains including seed. Separate SCTG categories cover animal feed and milled grain products.
Weight and value have separate units. Multiple modes and mail is a separate published mode. The dataset does not identify each leg of such shipments.
